import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 6010;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int n, m, k, c, d, edgeCount, totalCost;
    static int[] a = new int[MAXN], x = new int[MAXN], y = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN], pre = new int[MAXN], dist = new int[MAXN], inQueue = new int[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static final int T = 6000;
    static final int S = 0;

    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, cost, next;
        public Edge(int to, int capacity, int cost, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static int node_id(int t, int v) {
        return t * n + v;
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        edges.add(new Edge(v, cap, cost, head[u]));
        head[u] = edges.size() - 1;
        edges.add(new Edge(u, 0, -cost, head[v]));
        head[v] = edges.size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, 0);
        q.clear();
        dist[s] = 0;
        q.offer(s);
        inQueue[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            inQueue[v] = 0;
            for (int i = head[v]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                int u = e.to;
                if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[u] > dist[v] + e.cost) {
                    dist[u] = dist[v] + e.cost;
                    pre[u] = i;
                    if (inQueue[u] == 0) {
                        q.offer(u);
                        inQueue[u] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < INF;
    }

    static void augment(int s, int t) {
        for (int i = t; i != s; i = edges.get(pre[i] ^ 1).to) {
            Edge e = edges.get(pre[i]);
            e.capacity--;
            edges.get(pre[i] ^ 1).capacity++;
        }
        totalCost += dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(S, node_id(0, a[i]), 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            x[i] = sc.nextInt();
            y[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= 100; t++) {
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                add_edge(node_id(t, i), node_id(t + 1, i), k, c);
            }
            add_edge(node_id(t, 1), T, k, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= Math.min(k, 25); j++) {
                    add_edge(node_id(t, x[i]), node_id(t + 1, y[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                    add_edge(node_id(t, y[i]), node_id(t + 1, x[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        while (spfa(S, T)) {
            augment(S, T);
        }
        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
